evidence: A Dyson cleaner head with hair removal vanes and a purple extension wand are visible.
missing_evidence: The main handheld body, dust bin, handle, power controls, and display are out of frame.
decision.retake: Capture a photo showing the vacuum's main body, dust bin, and handle controls.

candidate_checks.evidence: The perpendicular dust bin and cyclone body are out of frame.
The in-line dust bin, trigger handle, and rear display are out of frame.
The slim motor body and push-button power control are out of frame.
The canister body, cyclone assembly, and hose connection are out of frame.
The main body with the CleanCompaktor mechanism is out of frame, and attachment compatibility alone cannot exclude it.
The visible cleaner head features a single roller with hair removal vanes, contradicting the WashG1 dual-roller wet head.

o1.refinement_reason: The main vacuum body, dust bin, and control layout must be inspected to distinguish between Dyson cordless families.
